pair_orientation_requirements: score(A, B) is produced under the frozen binding
score(B, A) is produced as a separate comparison
whether the two agree is published as a finding
the frozen binding is applied to every pair regardless of the finding
self_semantics_requirements: image A is loaded and extracted to a probe representation
image A is loaded and extracted again to a separate gallery representation
no representation is reused, cached or shared between the two sides
failure_semantics_rule: a failure is a structured failure, exception or status, and never a pseudo-score; a score of 0 is a legitimate score wherever the matcher returns one

failure_semantics_causes.what_it_establishes: a structurally broken image is refused rather than scored
an image the extractor declines produces a status, not a number
an absent input is refused before any scoring
the licence refusal is reported as itself, where this can be provoked safely
a controlled synthetic misuse returns a structured error

required_passes.what_it_is: score(A, B) under the frozen role binding
score(A, B) again, same process, same objects
score(A, B) again, same process, newly constructed objects
score(A, B) again, in a separate process
score(B, A), to observe the documented asymmetry
SELF(A, A) from two independent extractions

permitted_fixture_sources: official vendor fingerprint samples shipped inside the delivered package
local non-SD300 fixtures generated by this project
